## Outcome

What player/contributor outcome does this change produce, and what is explicitly
out of scope?

## Evidence

- Issue/risk scope and why these checks are sufficient:
- Tests/commands run:
- Full `release-check` run (yes/no, and why):
- Seed and world identity when deterministic output changes:
- Screenshots/video/audio evidence when presentation changes:
- Native/web/content-pack evidence when those surfaces change:

## Invariant impact

- [ ] Ordinary offline play still works.
- [ ] Chapter 1 remains the honest default product boundary.
- [ ] Generation/save compatibility is unchanged, or the version/migration is documented.
- [ ] Content-pack schema/digest/order impact is documented.
- [ ] Accessibility and lower-cost hardware impact were considered.
- [ ] No credentials, private references, local paths, or release secrets are included.

## Rights and provenance

List the origin, author, tool/model, license, and modification history of every
new asset, audio file, quotation, mark, likeness, dataset, or generated source.
Write `code/docs only; no new third-party material` when that is true.

## Review

- [ ] I read `CONTRIBUTING.md` and signed every commit according to `DCO.md`.
- [ ] Generated outputs are included only where the documented workflow requires them.
- [ ] This change does not assume that discussion or contribution transfers final product/canon authority.
